title: Wrap up: tests + verification for FreeTransform marquee and dashed Selection outline
summary: Both features' code is now in the working tree: Feature 1 (FreeTransform drag ⇒ `PickInRect`, marquee preview, `contains_rect` → `overlaps` in `Editor::objects_in_frame`) was verified in the diff earlier, and Feature 2 (dashed per-object/fallback selection outlines when the Selection tool is active, solid under Free Transform, via a `dashed_outline` helper in `stage.rs`) was completed by the second pass. Only the test work and the verification run remain.
